results.name: LEGO Botanicals Cozy Plants - Building Toy for Girls & Boys, Ages 9+ - Fun Activity & Craft for Kids - Book Shelf & Desk Decor - Gift for Birthdays - 10371
results.text: Add a colorful burst of cute and cozy decor to any room with the LEGO Botanicals Cozy Plants (10371) building toy for kids ages 9 years old and up. These decorative brick-built plants are cheerful, customizable and make the perfect gift for any plant lover. Young nature fans can have lots of fun building their own peppermint plant and chamomile plant, each in a cozy plant pot. There's a brown plant pot reading a book and a purple plant pot holding a cup of tea, each with an adorable smiley face that's sure to bring cheer to any room. The plants and pots are also interchangeable, so kids can mix and match them to customize their display. Once complete, this cozy building set makes for a charming piece of room decor, perfect for a girl or boy's bedroom, an office desk or any shelf with space to brighten. The set can also be combined with other happy plant building toys from the LEGO Botanicals collection (each sold separately) for an even more personalized display. It makes a great birthday gift for 9-year-old girls and boys, as well as plant lovers, book lovers or tea drinkers of all ages. With the LEGO Builder app, kids can zoom in, rotate models in 3D, save sets and track their progress using a digital version of the printed instructions. Contains 248 pieces.
